title: Підрядні означальні
rule: Who — для людей, which — для речей, that — для людей/речей у defining-реченнях, whose — належність, where — місце. У non-defining (з комами) that вживати не можна: My boss, who lives in Lviv, is kind. Займенник не повторюється: the app that I use (не that I use it).

items.prompt: The man ___ lives next door is a developer.
This is the tool ___ I use for debugging.
items.explanation: Для речі в defining-реченні підходить that.

items.prompt: She is the colleague ___ laptop was stolen.
That's the café ___ we first met.
My brother, ___ lives in Berlin, is a designer.
items.explanation: У non-defining реченні that не вживається; для людини who.

items.prompt: Python, ___ is easy to learn, is very popular.
items.explanation: У non-defining реченні для речі — which.

items.prompt: Everything ___ you said was correct.
I didn't understand ___ he said.
items.explanation: What = the thing which, без попереднього іменника.

items.prompt: The team, most of ___ are remote, is based in Poland.
The woman ___ I spoke to was very helpful.
The developer ___ (who / which) wrote this function has left.
The book ___ (that / which) I bought yesterday is great.
I know a place ___ (where) you can get good coffee.
Kate, ___ (whose) brother works at Google, helped me.
This is the bug ___ (that / which) caused the crash.
The reason ___ (why) I left was personal.
The man who he lives next door is a developer.
answers: The man who lives next door is a developer.
The man that lives next door is a developer.

items.prompt: This is the app which I told you about it.
answers: This is the app which I told you about.
This is the app that I told you about.
This is the app I told you about.

items.prompt: The girl which works here is my sister.
answers: The girl who works here is my sister.
The girl that works here is my sister.
items.explanation: Для людей вживаємо who або that, а не which.

items.prompt: My boss, that lives in Lviv, is very kind.
answers: My boss, who lives in Lviv, is very kind.
